name: The Horde Needs Heavy Leather!
label: Quest
description: The Horde Needs Heavy Leather!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Since we're preparing for war, it might be best if we get all of the goods we need first, don't you think, mon? One of the staples of the war materiel that we're producing is heavy leather. We'll use it for just about everything, from reinforcement to armor, and good old plain tarps too.
But first we need to get our hands on more of it. That's your job, adventurer. Sharpen your knife and bring me back a bundle. Then we'll talk further.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I've got no time for games if you're just here to jibber-jabber, adventurer. There are too many stacks of heavy leather that need curing. Come back when you have at least ten for me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, so you do have the heavy leather I needed. Your blade is sharp indeed, adventurer; these are good skins! Now that we've gotten off on the right foot with one another I'll make sure that your contribution is put to good use. And if you happen to come across more heavy leather, bring it my way.
